lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Whoa! Jabu, look at that tree! Its tummy is bigger than yours!
lines.text: Aisee! Jabu, tazama ule mti! Tumbo lake ni kubwa kuliko lako!

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Okay, okay. Maybe not bigger. But why is the trunk so wide?
lines.text: Sawa, sawa. Labda si kubwa zaidi. Lakini kwa nini shina lake ni pana hivyo?

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: We need berries for our jam. One basket for us, and one little bowl to share.
lines.text: Tunahitaji beri kwa ajili ya jamu yetu. Kikapu kimoja kwa ajili yetu, na bakuli dogo moja la kushirikiana.

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Let’s count together. One, two, three, four, five!
lines.text: Tuhesabu pamoja. Moja, mbili, tatu, nne, tano!

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Jabu, your trunk is the fastest berry-picker I’ve ever seen.
lines.text: Jabu, mkonga wako ndiye mchuma beri mwenye kasi zaidi niliyewahi kuona.

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: First, bowl. Then berries. Then mash. Then stir. In that order!
lines.text: Kwanza, bakuli. Kisha beri. Kisha tunaziponda. Kisha tunakoroga. Kwa mpangilio huo!

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Catch the purple one! No, the other purple one!
lines.text: Kamata ile ya zambarau! Hapana, ile nyingine ya zambarau!

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Well... that did not go to plan.

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: But we can fix it. We’ll pick up, clean up, and try again.
lines.text: Lakini tunaweza kurekebisha. Tutaokota, kusafisha, halafu tujaribu tena.

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: You gather. I sort. Then we both stir.
lines.text: Wewe kusanya. Mimi nitapanga. Halafu tutakoroga pamoja.

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Look! A small pot of jam and a very big adventure.
lines.text: Tazama! Chungu kidogo cha jamu na safari kubwa sana.

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Baobabs grow in several parts of Africa. Their thick trunks can store lots of water, which helps them through dry times.
lines.text: Miti ya baobab hukua katika sehemu mbalimbali za Afrika. Mashina yake makubwa yanaweza kuhifadhi maji mengi, jambo linaloisaidia wakati wa ukame.

lines.speaker: Lebo
lines.source: Africa is full of different places, people, plants and stories. We’ll discover another one next time.
lines.text: Afrika imejaa maeneo, watu, mimea na hadithi mbalimbali. Tutagundua nyingine wakati ujao.
